caption:
Comparing your life to theirs? Read this

Allah tells us not to look with longing at the splendor of this life that others were given as a trial. The provision of your Lord is far better and more lasting.

Surah Taa-Haa 20:131

Before your next scroll, thank Allah for one thing you already have.

#comparison #contentment #surahtaha #muslimmindset

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: Do not turn your eyes covetously towards the various forms of splendor of this life that We have given some of the [disbelievers] to enjoy, as a trial for them. But the provision of your Lord is far better and more lasting (Surah Taa-Haa 20:131)
theme: comparison / contentment, Allah's provision is better
